name: HubSpot Custom Code Action Error Handler

parameters.content:
## HubSpot Custom Code Action Error Handler
HubSpot custom code actions report failures here (see hubspot/custom-code-wrapper.js). Errors are parsed, classified, alerted to Slack, logged to Datadog or the console, and recovered by retry (record flag + re-enrolment) or fallback (flag + task).

**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` routes everything to *Dry-Run Telemetry*.

Code nodes are generated from `error-parser.js` by `npm run build`; do not edit them in n8n.

nodes.name: HubSpot Error Webhook
nodes.notes: Responds immediately (200) so the HubSpot action is not slowed down. Authenticated by the x-hs-error-secret header in the next node.

nodes.name: Normalize & Parse Errors
nodes.notes: Authenticates, parses stack traces and API errors, classifies, de-duplicates alerts and plans recovery.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Sandbox branch: logs planned alerts, logs and recovery actions.

nodes.name: Slack Alert Router
nodes.notes: Events below ALERT_MIN_SEVERITY or de-duplicated within ALERT_DEDUPE_MINUTES match no rule and are not posted.

nodes.name: Slack Critical Alert
nodes.notes: Incoming Webhook from SLACK_CRITICAL_WEBHOOK_URL (critical errors such as AUTH and CODE).

nodes.name: Console Logger
nodes.notes: Structured JSON line per event on stdout (when Datadog is disabled).

nodes.name: Retry / Fallback Router
nodes.notes: NONE (no record reference, or recovery disabled) matches no rule.

nodes.name: Retry Backoff
nodes.notes: Exponential backoff with jitter (RETRY_BASE_DELAY_SECONDS × 2^attempt, capped at RETRY_MAX_DELAY_SECONDS).

nodes.name: HubSpot Request Retry
nodes.notes: Sets cca_error_status=RETRY_REQUESTED and increments cca_retry_count; the HubSpot workflow re-enrols on that change.

nodes.name: HubSpot Flag Fallback
nodes.notes: Sets cca_error_status=FALLBACK plus last-error details for a fallback branch or view.

nodes.name: HubSpot Create Fallback Task
nodes.notes: Task for RevOps / the fallback owner, associated with the failed record.
